stem.text: An organic ion containing a carbon atom with a negative charge is called a carbanion.
An organic ion containing a carbon atom with a positive charge is called a carbocation.
The reaction between $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ and 1-bromobutane proceeds by an $\text{S}_{\text{N}}2$ mechanism.
What is the first step in the mechanism?

A.text: attack by a nucleophile on a carbon atom with a partial positive charge

B.text: heterolytic bond fission followed by attack by an electrophile on a carbanion

C.text: heterolytic bond fission followed by attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation

D.text: homolytic bond fission followed by attack by a nucleophile on a carbocation
